item.title: Virgin Media viewers unlock TV channel that's been exclusive to Sky for the last 15 years (at no extra cost!)
item.description: Sky Atlantic is coming to Virgin Media TV on April 1, 2026.The popular channel will be available to over a million Virgin TV subscribers overnight – at no extra cost.
